rationale: Both 8.59 ns runs ended ~1.4 ns positive, so timing repair never engaged and the target is at its floor: T_eff reflects the AREA 3 netlist, placement and electrical repair. Loose-target runs fit T_eff ~ 0.2*T + 4.7 (IO-delay limited), so the tight target stays. Among timing-driven AREA 3 runs, T_eff tends to improve with placement density (41%: 7.64, 55%: 7.55, 57%: 7.15, 65%: 7.27); the best four share cap213, TDP and no routability mode. A: best run packed tighter (util 46, density 70) to shorten critical wires. B: best run's floorplan with maximal slew/cap repair margins plus post-GRT design repair, to strengthen drivers on loaded critical nets. 0.4 ns margins keep the re-check robust.
